## Runtime and Ratings

@fig-runtime-rating shows the relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating.

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.show()
```

## Mean Rating by Decade

::: {#3b3837e8 .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
